description: Keeps each task definition's pinned image digest current within the tag it names.

customManagers.description: The image a task definition pins: the tag in the comment directly above exec.image, and the digest on that line.

packageRules.description: A definition is pinned to one release line, so only the digest behind its tag may move. A new line is a new definition, added by hand.
One pull request for every definition whose image was rebuilt upstream that week.
